description.value: Hawker's Delight is an Asian fast-food counter on Vancouver's busy Main Street corridor, drawing its name from the hawker-stall street food tradition of Southeast Asia. It operates as a walk-in, counter-service spot with no drive-through, making it a quick stop for cyclists passing through the Main Street–Mount Pleasant area. A Facebook presence (@hawkersdelightdeli) suggests an active, community-facing operation.
